Method of Attack: Remote command execution with SYSTEM privileges without authentication
Exploits the Sirep test service on Windows 10 IoT Core devices
Allows attackers to launch commands, upload/download files, and exfiltrate system information
Impacted Systems: Embedded and IoT cable-connected devices running Windows 10 IoT Core
Attack Vector: Ethernet (cable-connected devices) via TCP connection to Sirep service port
Indicators of Compromise: Sirep test service running by default on official Microsoft stock images
